newsitem.title: USA: Energy Conversion, Sanoh to form battery venture.
newsitem.headline: Energy Conversion, Sanoh to form battery venture.

text.p: Energy Conversion Devices Inc said Wednesday that its Ovonic Battery Co and Sanoh Industrial Co Ltd have agreed to manufacture and sell Ovonic nickel metal hydride (NiMH) batteries for electric vehicles in Europe.

Ovonic Battery, 45 percent owner of a new European joint venture between the two companies, said it will provide the necessary licenses and technical know-how. Sanoh, 55 percent owner of the venture, will provide the necessary funding for the operations and capital expenses.
In addition to its 45 percent equity, Ovonic Battery said it will receive total payments of up to $5 million as part of the deal.
The agreement also provides for other interested companies to invest in the as yet unnamed venture as additional shareholders.

"Our goal is to be the leading manufacturer and supplier of Ovonic NiMH batteries to the emerging market for zero emission electric two- and three-wheeled vehicles," Energy Conversion Devices President Stanford Ovshinsky said in a statement. "This agreement is a landmark step in our company's continuing strategy to help create a new segment in the transportation industry."

Sanoh, a Japanese automotive parts company, has a license to produce Ovonic NiMH batteries for two- and three-wheeled vehicles in Japan. Initial battery production has started at the Sanoh plant in Koga, Japan. Sanoh has also been making various components for Ovonic electric vehicle batteries.
